description: Every 30 minutes, scans the connected Outlook inbox for new-patient enquiries, uses AI to judge which are genuine, drafts a reply using Cliniko's own billable items and open appointment slots (never invented), and raises a WorkQ approval item using the same decision form as No-show Recovery - so sending it is handled by that automation's existing Apply no-show follow-up decision flow, not a new one. Also records the enquiry thread so Convert enquiry to booked patient can recognise a reply.
